rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name + ZIP to a unique user, then accessed the correct order. It answered the split-payment limitation correctly and did not reveal account info before authentication. When the user asked to cancel an item, the agent correctly stated item-level cancellation wasn’t supported and offered permissible alternatives. Before canceling the entire order, it stated the exact change (cancel order #W9348897) and obtained explicit confirmation plus a reason. It then executed the cancellation via the correct tool and provided a reasonable refund confirmation. No writes were performed without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims were made based on the available tool outputs. Minor uncertainties (e.g., refund timing detail) do not materially impact compliance or outcome quality.
